_comments.body:
Looks like the issue is in this line:
https://github.com/microsoft/BitNet/blob/main/run_inference.py#L48C137-L48C140

One can change this default, adding the `-n -1` option to the command line.

-1 is the default in llama.cpp

body:
When I prompt it to generate more output, like a python script, it abruptly truncates the responses, returning to a prompt. I can then press `Ctl+D` or `Enter` and the output continues. The same seems to happen when compiling and running the api server (I used https://github.com/abstratium-dev/bitnet-llm project to compile/run the server) i.e. - I get truncated responses in Roo Code when I plug the api server as an LM Studio API Provider.

I've seen similar reports of truncated output here: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=43714004
